description.silhouette: 5 x 4 m open construction yard: site hut or pole barn, plan table, crane or gantry, timber, stone and sack stacks.
description.colors: Weathered timber, faded signal ochre steel, galvanized sheet, burlap, cream plans, amber beacon.
description.anatomy: One BU is one metre / 32 display pixels. Footprint x -2.5..2.5, y -2..2 m inside a 6 m canvas; working front faces south. Real structural floors only, no environment ground or baked shadow.
description.animation: Static; embers, lamps, windows and beacons are separate emission materials.
